title: Obstetrics and gynecology clerkship
audience: a medical student in the clinical years preparing for the USMLE
purpose: Manage prenatal care, labor and delivery, hypertensive and medical disorders of pregnancy, bleeding, preterm labor, postpartum care, menstrual disorders, contraception and family planning, infertility, menopause, gynecologic cancer screening, pelvic pain and infections.

weeks.4: Diabetes and other medical problems in pregnancy
weeks.6: Preterm labor and rupture of membranes

blocks.deliverable: Build a prenatal visit schedule with its screening tests.
Distinguish placenta previa and placental abruption.
Week 7 midterm; manage postpartum hemorrhage step by step.
Counsel on contraception for patients with medical conditions.
Submit the project; take an unseen 180 minute final in week 14.

project: Prenatal care timeline: build a trimester-by-trimester schedule of visits, screening tests and counseling for a supplied patient.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
